approval_required_for: Any change to the bottom-up hierarchy or merge order, including bypassing leaf, single-layer, multilayer, or deadlock gates before AXI/DDR handoff.
Any change to Stage 4 numeric policy, cast points, rounding mode, saturation behavior, or numeric_compare tolerance.
Any change to Stage 3 stream order, beat pipeline, FIFO/liveness/watchdog policy, or multilayer pipeline structure.
Any change to memory layout, runtime ABI, DDR transfer units, or address map consumed by functional_sim or AXI/DDR handoff.
Any major generated-template, architecture, or board-wrapper repair beyond bounded contract-guided localization.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not approve AXI/DDR handoff; return the failed dependency edge and violated SACG constraint to Stage 6 contract repair, and require approval if the repair changes hierarchy, stream order, or numeric policy.
executable_actions.rationale: Re-run the static verification DAG audit over the full unsliced merge_agents and gate_dag so attention, MLP, single-block, and presence_summary-declared multilayer merge details are bound to SACG stream order, beat alignment, and numeric policy before handoff.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block case_leaf_functional, case_leaf_golden_compare, single_transformer_layer, multilayer, and functional_sim gates; repair the manifest/scaffold/golden-reference tooling rather than claiming hardware failure.
executable_actions.rationale: Real input/weight manifests and a reproducible, hashable testbench scaffold are prerequisites for leaf, single-layer, multilayer, and functional_sim acceptance; default generated weights are explicitly not acceptance evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Localize the earliest violated leaf boundary using the debug closure contract; do not run single_transformer_layer until the failed leaf checker is repaired and rerun.
executable_actions.rationale: Every spatial operator leaf stage must pass static boundary, functional, numeric golden, data-order, and transfer-count checks before attention/MLP merge or single-layer promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop before case_multilayer_pipeline; use boundary bisection across the connected leaf-to-layer path and rerun the failed checker after bounded repair.
executable_actions.rationale: After leaf closure, connect the verified spatial stages into the single transformer layer and require real functional, golden compare, stream-order, and transfer-count evidence before any multilayer pipeline claim.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block case_board_interface_discovery and all AXI/DDR/backend gates; localize the earliest layer-to-layer or upstream leaf boundary before pipeline_repair, then rerun the failed gate.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after single-layer golden comparison may the multilayer scaffold be verified; liveness/deadlock evidence must be real tool output with stream-order, transfer-count, and numeric obligations preserved.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep functional_sim, Vivado, bitstream, and board_runtime blocked; repair the Stage 6 verification contract rather than relying on human memory or static scripts.
executable_actions.rationale: Create enforceable rules for downstream agents: functional_sim is not satisfied by candidate labels or smoke runs, must use real input/weight artifacts, must follow multilayer deadlock and AXI/DDR roundtrip evidence, and must pass before Vivado/backend promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not proceed to Vivado synthesis or implementation; send simulator evidence to contract-guided localization with the violated SACG constraints and earliest failing boundary.
executable_actions.rationale: After AXI protocol and DDR image roundtrip evidence is produced by the downstream AXI/DDR specialist, run the real functional simulator with the declared manifests and enforce numeric, data-order, artifact-hash, and liveness checks before any backend promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the failed layer blocked and create a retry/backtrack request only with the failed checker, violated contract, and missing localization evidence; any architecture, pipeline, memory, numeric, or major template change requires explicit approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Any leaf, single-layer, multilayer, deadlock, or functional_sim failure must enter the three-layer repair loop: operator/leaf first, then connected single-transformer-layer, then AXI/DDR-wrapped system. Repairs must be bounded by the debug closure contract and rerun the failed checker.

observations: SACG memory truth in the supplied state reports zero active contamination barriers, zero open retry requests, and zero open backtrack requests; no current SACG-memory blocker applies to this review.

Upstream Stage 3, Stage 4, and Stage 5 evidence is visible and ready: pipeline planning has stream/data edges and attention semantics, parameter binding has numeric cast points and passed static checks, and code generation compile/elaboration and contract checks passed.

The current-stage contract status is pass, with hierarchical_verification_plan_check passing and data_order_trace_check passing as a static trace ledger. deadlock_watchdog is explicitly pending downstream, which is not a current-stage failure under the supplied stage_gate_policy.

The visible merge dependencies preserve bottom-up order: self-attention merge depends on rms_norm_1, self_attention, and residual_add_1; MLP merge depends on rms_norm_2, gate/up projections, activation_mul, down projection, and residual_add_2; single_decoder_block depends on the attention and MLP merges plus real weight, scaffold, single-layer functional, and single-layer golden gates.

presence_summary reports six merge agents, thirty-one DAG nodes, twenty-two evidence gates, and thirty-one evidence path requirements. Some detailed rows are omitted in this role slice, so missing-detail concerns are handoff audit items rather than current blockers while the visible checker status remains pass.

Numeric comparison obligations are declared at leaf and single-layer levels and must follow Stage 4 numeric policy: fp16 activations/weights, fp32 accumulator/residual paths, nearest_even rounding, no saturation, and the declared cast points. Golden comparisons must not loosen tolerance or change golden outputs.

Stream-order obligations are correctly carried from Stage 3 into downstream data_order_trace_check and transfer-count checks. GQA semantics are fixed as causal GQA with 14 query heads, 2 KV heads, group size 7, head_dim 64, RoPE theta 1000000.0, and seq_len_bound 16.

Functional simulation candidates are explicitly marked as not acceptance by label alone. Real input and weight artifacts, a hashable testbench scaffold, real functional simulation, numeric compare, data-order trace, and deadlock/liveness evidence remain required before backend promotion.

The DAG blocks AXI/DDR wrapping until case_multilayer_functional and case_pipeline_deadlock_check complete, and blocks Vivado/backend until functional_sim completes after AXI protocol and DDR image roundtrip evidence. This preserves the required leaf -> single layer -> multilayer -> AXI/DDR -> backend order.
proposed_actions: Approve the current-stage single/multilayer verification DAG segment as a satisfiable static contract, while marking all real tool evidence as pending downstream execution.
Run an unsliced merge-gate dependency audit to bind all attention, MLP, single-block, and multilayer merge rows to SACG stream order, beat alignment, numeric policy, and hierarchy constraints.
Materialize real input/weight artifacts and a hashable testbench scaffold before any functional or golden comparison gate; reject default weights and smoke-only acceptance.
Execute closure strictly bottom-up: leaf static/functional/golden gates, then single_transformer_layer functional and golden compare, then multilayer pipeline functional and liveness/deadlock gates.
Require data_order_trace_check, transfer_count_check, numeric_compare, and deadlock_watchdog evidence at the integration boundaries where they are declared; do not promote on static hierarchy alone.

Hand off functional_sim_prebackend_blocking_rules to axi_ddr_runtime_verification_architect and verification_evidence_gate_auditor: functional_sim must wait for multilayer liveness plus AXI protocol and DDR image roundtrip evidence and must pass before Vivado/backend.

On any verification failure, use boundary-contract-guided localization and targeted replay to find the earliest causal boundary before bounded repair; do not skip directly to higher-layer or board repair.
risks: Downstream execution risk: if pending deadlock_watchdog, real simulator, or board/backend gates are treated as pass based on contract declaration alone, SACG evidence would be contaminated. required_real_tool_evidence_check must gate promotion.

Handoff audit risk: the compact slice shows only part of the merge_agents and required_tool_protocols details, while presence_summary states the full classes exist. The evidence-gate auditor must check the unsliced artifact for all six merge agents and all required path/protocol rows.

Numeric consistency risk: a golden-reference or packer mismatch at fp16/fp32 cast boundaries could look like RTL failure. The first repair must classify missing or inconsistent checker/golden capability as checker/golden-reference repair, not hardware correctness.

Stream and transfer-count risk: GQA head grouping, RoPE ordering, lane mapping, residual precision, and layer-to-layer beat alignment can fail without violating static hierarchy. Downstream traces must include transaction, tile, logical index, lane mapping, and transfer-count evidence.

Liveness risk: fifo_depth 16, lanes 8, seq_len 16, and multilayer backpressure require real deadlock watchdog evidence. A timeout must localize the earliest leaf, single-layer, or layer-to-layer boundary before any repair is proposed.
Real-artifact risk: case_real_weight_artifacts and case_tb_scaffold are required pending execution. Default generated weights or smoke tests cannot satisfy functional correctness acceptance.

Cross-stage ABI risk: functional_sim depends on AXI/DDR protocol and DDR image roundtrip evidence after this role's segment. Any later memory-layout or runtime ABI change must preserve the already declared stream/numeric contracts or obtain approval before reuse.
